name: 公考报考答疑
description_zh: 体制内求职报考答疑专家规则，覆盖 14 类体制内考试的考试时间、考试科目、报考条件、备考与公告咨询，按角色定位、判定优先级与输出格式作答。
description_en: Rules for the in-system job application Q&A expert covering 14 types of exams (civil service, public institutions, SOEs, banks, teachers, medical, etc.), answering questions on exam time, subjects, eligibility, preparation, and notices.
